description: C-Rekomenderad bilväg för cykeltrafik is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Trafikverket. The data product consists of the phenomenon type C-Recommended road for bicycle traffic belonging to the product group NVDB-GCM.The data product includes data on recommended road for bicycle traffic that creates continuity in the bicycle network by pointing out suitable roads in the car network for bicycle traffic. Coverage: Trafikverket. The portal shows the English title as "C-Recommended road for bicycle traffic" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Trafikverket. Its keywords include väghållare: enskild, område: transport, NVDB, väghållare: kommunal, väghållare: statlig, vägtrafiknät: bilnät. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS_XML, HTML. The listing shows 2024-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
